from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from native_camera import VIEWS
from native_scene import VARIABLES
from saved_conditions import FIELDS, measure as _measure


def measure(*args, **kwargs):
    """Expose the original-condition measurement used by this finalizer."""
    return _measure(*args, **kwargs)


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _document(path: Path) -> dict:
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + path.name)
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def _rows(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + path.name)
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
            if line.strip()]


def _finite(value, name: str) -> float:
    if type(value) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(value):
        raise ValueError("invalid original " + name)
    return float(value)


def recording_description(attempt: Path | None = None) -> dict:
    if attempt is not None and (Path(attempt) / "config.json").is_file():
        config = _document(Path(attempt) / "config.json")
        if config.get("selected_case_id") != config.get("case", {}).get("case_id"):
            raise ValueError("materialized recording case identity differs")
        description = config["case"].get("recording_description")
        if not isinstance(description, dict) or not description.get("channels"):
            raise ValueError("materialized recording description missing")
        return description
    channels = []
    units = {"ego_speed_mps": "m/s", "leader_gap_m": "m", "highway_width_m": "m",
             "roadway_driving_width_m": "m", "shoulder_width_m": "m",
             "surface_wetness": "fraction", "precipitation_strength": "Native scale",
             "fog_density": "Native scale", "tire_friction": "Native tire friction"}
    for name in FIELDS:
        channels.append({"name": name, "unit": units[name],
                         "source": "original-conditions.jsonl", "field": name})
    return {"format": "c179789-basic-speed-recording-description-v1",
            "channels": channels, "context_inputs": [
                {"name": "authored_speed_conditions", "unit": "reviewed setup",
                 "source": "authored-setup.json"},
                {"name": "original_road_actor_ids", "unit": "Native source identities",
                 "source": "original-conditions.jsonl"}],
            "legal_judgment": "unresolved"}


def _source_bundle(attempt: Path) -> tuple[dict, dict, list[dict], dict]:
    setup_path = attempt / "authored-setup.json"
    setup = _document(setup_path)
    setup_seal = _document(attempt / "authored-setup-seal.json")
    if (setup_seal.get("format") != "c179789-authored-setup-v1" or
            setup_seal.get("case_id") != setup.get("case_id") or
            setup_seal.get("sha256") != sha(setup_path)):
        raise ValueError("authored setup seal differs")
    plan = _document(Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "case-plan.json")
    exact_cases = {item["case_id"] for item in plan["cases"]}
    if (setup.get("case_id") not in exact_cases or
            setup.get("paved_road") is not True or
            not setup.get("travel_direction") or
            not isinstance(setup.get("variables"), dict) or
            set(setup["variables"]) != set(VARIABLES)):
        raise ValueError("authored setup does not bind one exact paved-road case")
    if not (attempt / "original-conditions.jsonl").is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: original-conditions.jsonl")
    conditions = measure(attempt, setup["case_id"])
    rows = _rows(attempt / "trace.jsonl")
    mapping = _rows(attempt / "video_frames.jsonl")
    if len(rows) != 900 or len(mapping) != 900 or conditions["sample_count"] != 900:
        raise ValueError("original 900-frame duration differs")
    source_hash = setup.get("source_packet_sha256")
    if (not isinstance(source_hash, str) or len(source_hash) != 64 or
            conditions["source_ids"]["opendrive_sha256"] != setup.get("opendrive_sha256")):
        raise ValueError("reviewed setup and original OpenDRIVE source differ")
    for index, (row, mapped, condition) in enumerate(zip(rows, mapping,
                                                          conditions["full_history"])):
        frame, time_s = condition["frame"], condition["time_s"]
        if (row.get("frame") != frame or row.get("source_frame") != frame or
                row.get("time_s") != time_s or row.get("condition_sample_index") != index or
                row.get("source_packet_sha256") != source_hash or
                row.get("physical_acceptance_claimed") is not False or
                mapped.get("video_frame") != index or mapped.get("carla_frame") != frame or
                mapped.get("native_frame") != frame or mapped.get("time_s") != time_s):
            raise ValueError("original trace, condition and frame map join differs")
        camera = row.get("camera_sources")
        hashes = mapped.get("camera_source_sha256")
        if (not isinstance(camera, dict) or set(camera) != {name for name, _, _ in VIEWS} or
                not isinstance(hashes, dict) or set(hashes) != set(camera) or
                any(not isinstance(camera[name], dict) or
                    hashes[name] != camera[name].get("sha256") for name in camera)):
            raise ValueError("original camera/frame map hash join differs")
        position = row.get("position_m")
        if (not isinstance(position, list) or len(position) != 3 or
                any(type(value) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(value)
                    for value in position)):
            raise ValueError("original ego position missing")
    receipt = _document(attempt / "media-receipt.json")
    if (receipt.get("format") != "c179789-original-four-camera-media-v1" or
            receipt.get("frames") != 900 or
            receipt.get("source_packet_sha256") != source_hash or
            receipt.get("trace_sha256") != sha(attempt / "trace.jsonl") or
            receipt.get("frame_map_sha256") != sha(attempt / "video_frames.jsonl") or
            receipt.get("physical_acceptance_claimed") is not False):
        raise ValueError("original media source receipt differs")
    status = _document(attempt / "native-run-status.json")
    if (status.get("case_id") != setup["case_id"] or
            status.get("capture", {}).get("frames") != 900 or
            status.get("restoration", {}).get("restored") is not True or
            status.get("errors") != []):
        raise ValueError("original Native runner/restoration status differs")
    videos = receipt.get("video_sha256")
    if not isinstance(videos, dict) or set(videos) != {name for name, _, _ in VIEWS}:
        raise ValueError("original four-view media receipt differs")
    for name, _, _ in VIEWS:
        path = attempt / (name + ".mkv")
        if not path.is_file() or not path.stat().st_size or sha(path) != videos[name]:
            raise ValueError("original four-view video bytes differ")
    return setup, conditions, rows, receipt


def analyze(attempt: Path) -> tuple[dict, dict, dict]:
    """Read sealed sources and derive requested-versus-observed metrics."""
    attempt = Path(attempt).resolve()
    setup, conditions, rows, receipt = _source_bundle(attempt)
    suffix = conditions["full_history"][180:]
    steady = {name: sum(row[name] for row in suffix) / len(suffix) for name in FIELDS}
    first, last = rows[0]["position_m"], rows[-1]["position_m"]
    progress = math.dist(first, last)
    requested = setup.get("variables")
    if not isinstance(requested, dict):
        raise ValueError("authored speed/condition variables missing")
    targets = (
        ("ego_speed_mps", "ego_speed_request_mps", 1.0),
        ("leader_gap_m", "leader_initial_gap_m", 3.0),
        ("surface_wetness", "surface_wetness_request", .05),
        ("highway_width_m", "highway_width_m", .05),
        ("precipitation_strength", "native_precipitation_request", 2.0),
        ("fog_density", "native_fog_request", 2.0),
    )
    checks = []
    for observed, key, tolerance in targets:
        request = _finite(requested.get(key), key)
        value = steady[observed]
        checks.append({"target": observed, "requested": request, "measured": value,
                       "method": "mean original Native samples after first 180 of 900 frames",
                       "tolerance": tolerance, "matched": abs(value - request) <= tolerance,
                       "physical_cause_confirmed": False,
                       "cause_evidence": ["original-conditions.jsonl", "trace.jsonl"]})
    video_names = [name + ".mkv" for name, _, _ in VIEWS]
    recording = recording_description(attempt)
    evidence = []
    channel_values = {}
    for index, channel in enumerate(recording["channels"]):
        name = channel["name"]
        reference = f"channels/stream-{index:02d}.jsonl"
        channel_values[reference] = "".join(json.dumps({"time_s": row["time_s"],
                                                         "value": row[name]},
                                                        sort_keys=True) + "\n"
                                              for row in conditions["full_history"])
        evidence.append({"name": name, "unit": channel["unit"], "reference": reference})
    contexts = {"authored_speed_conditions": {"case_id": setup["case_id"],
                                                  "variables": requested,
                                                  "source_packet_sha256": setup["source_packet_sha256"]},
                "original_road_actor_ids": conditions["source_ids"]}
    for index, context in enumerate(recording["context_inputs"]):
        name = context["name"]
        reference = f"channels/context-{index:02d}.json"
        channel_values[reference] = json.dumps({name: contexts[name]}, sort_keys=True) + "\n"
        evidence.append({"name": name, "unit": context["unit"], "reference": reference})
    complete = progress >= .25
    native_result = {"case_id": setup["case_id"],
                     "measured_values": {"steady_means": steady,
                                         "travel_progress_m": progress,
                                         "conditions": conditions,
                                         "legal_judgment": "unresolved"},
                     "target_checks": checks,
                     "setup_confirmed": False,
                     "behavior_attempted": all(isinstance(row.get("control"), dict)
                                               for row in rows),
                     "maneuver_completed": complete,
                     "termination_reason": "planned 900-frame window",
                     "physical_failure_flags": [] if complete else ["travel progress under .25 m"],
                     "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl", "video_references": video_names,
                     "video_frame_map_reference": "video_frames.jsonl",
                     "recording_description": recording,
                     "recording_evidence": evidence, "realized_observables": {},
                     "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}
    hashes = {name: sha(attempt / name) for name in
              ("authored-setup.json", "authored-setup-seal.json",
               "original-conditions.jsonl", "original-conditions-seal.json",
               "trace.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl", "media-receipt.json",
               "native-run-status.json", *video_names)}
    report = {"format": "c179789-saved-analysis-draft-v1", "case_id": setup["case_id"],
              "measurements": {name: {"method": "measure", "value": value,
                                      "sources": {"original-conditions.jsonl":
                                                  hashes["original-conditions.jsonl"]}}
                               for name, value in steady.items()},
              "target_checks": checks, "sources": hashes,
              "original_media_receipt": receipt,
              "legal_judgment": "unresolved", "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}
    report["measurements"]["basic_speed_observation"] = {
        "method": "measure", "value": {
            "case_id": setup["case_id"], "steady_means": steady,
            "travel_progress_m": progress,
            "source_ids": conditions["source_ids"],
            "legal_judgment": "unresolved"},
        "sources": {name: hashes[name] for name in
                    ("authored-setup.json", "original-conditions.jsonl", "trace.jsonl")}}
    return report, native_result, channel_values


def finalize_attempt(attempt: Path, output: Path) -> dict:
    """Write saved channels and result once, retaining any incomplete attempt."""
    attempt = Path(attempt).resolve()
    output = Path(output).resolve()
    if output != attempt / "analysis-report.json":
        raise ValueError("analysis report must stay in the original attempt")
    if output.exists() or (attempt / "result.json").exists() or (attempt / "channels").exists():
        raise ValueError("retain previous saved analysis")
    report, result, channels = analyze(attempt)
    folder = attempt / "channels"
    folder.mkdir()
    for name, content in channels.items():
        (attempt / name).write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
    (attempt / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n",
                                         encoding="utf-8")
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return report


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(finalize_attempt(args.attempt, args.output), indent=2))

"""Independent source-bound check of authored and observed comparison isolation.

This checks engineering evidence only; reasonable/proper speed stays unresolved.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from saved_conditions import measure


OBSERVED = {
    "speed": "ego_speed_mps",
    "traffic": "leader_gap_m",
    "surface": "surface_wetness",
    "width": "highway_width_m",
    "weather": "precipitation_strength",
    "visibility": "fog_density",
}
DIRECTION = {"speed": 1, "traffic": -1, "surface": 1,
             "width": -1, "weather": 1, "visibility": 1}


def _read_setup(attempt: Path, case_id: str) -> tuple[dict, str]:
    path = attempt / "authored-setup.json"
    data = path.read_bytes()
    digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    seal = json.loads((attempt / "authored-setup-seal.json").read_bytes())
    if seal != {"format": "c179789-authored-setup-v1", "case_id": case_id, "sha256": digest}:
        raise ValueError("authored setup seal or case identity differs")
    setup = json.loads(data)
    if setup.get("case_id") != case_id or not isinstance(setup.get("variables"), dict):
        raise ValueError("authored setup identity or variables missing")
    if set(setup["variables"]) != {
        "ego_speed_request_mps", "leader_initial_gap_m", "surface_wetness_request",
        "highway_width_m", "native_precipitation_request", "native_fog_request",
    }:
        raise ValueError("authored setup variables incomplete")
    for name, value in setup["variables"].items():
        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (float, int)) or not math.isfinite(value) or value < 0:
            raise ValueError(f"invalid authored setup variable: {name}")
    for name in ("vehicle_blueprint", "travel_direction", "paved_road", "camera_profile", "duration_frames"):
        if name not in setup or setup[name] in (None, ""):
            raise ValueError(f"fixed authored setup missing: {name}")
    if setup["paved_road"] is not True:
        raise ValueError("paved road condition differs")
    return setup, digest


def audit(plan_path: Path, comparison_id: str, reference: Path, alternative: Path) -> dict:
    """Require two distinct sealed originals and only the declared setup change."""
    plan_bytes = Path(plan_path).read_bytes()
    plan = json.loads(plan_bytes)
    comparison = next((item for item in plan["comparisons"]
                       if item["comparison_id"] == comparison_id), None)
    if comparison is None or comparison_id not in OBSERVED:
        raise ValueError("unknown exact comparison")
    if Path(reference).resolve() == Path(alternative).resolve():
        raise ValueError("comparison attempts must be distinct")
    first_id, second_id = comparison["case_ids"]
    first_setup, first_hash = _read_setup(Path(reference), first_id)
    second_setup, second_hash = _read_setup(Path(alternative), second_id)
    difference = comparison["deliberate_differences"]
    if len(difference) != 1 or difference[0] not in first_setup["variables"]:
        raise ValueError("comparison declares an invalid authored difference")
    variable = difference[0]
    fixed = set(first_setup) - {"case_id", "variables"}
    if set(first_setup) != set(second_setup) or any(first_setup[key] != second_setup[key] for key in fixed):
        raise ValueError("fixed authored setup differs")
    changed = {key for key in first_setup["variables"]
               if first_setup["variables"][key] != second_setup["variables"][key]}
    if changed != {variable}:
        raise ValueError("declared comparison variable is not isolated")
    if DIRECTION[comparison_id] * (second_setup["variables"][variable] -
                                   first_setup["variables"][variable]) <= 0:
        raise ValueError("authored comparison direction differs")
    first = measure(reference, first_id)
    second = measure(alternative, second_id)
    if first["diagnostic_fixture"] or second["diagnostic_fixture"]:
        raise ValueError("diagnostic condition samples cannot prove a comparison")
    source_a, source_b = first["source_ids"], second["source_ids"]
    for key in ("road_id", "lane_id"):
        if source_a[key] != source_b[key] and comparison_id != "width":
            raise ValueError("roadway or travel lane differs")
    if source_a["opendrive_sha256"] != source_b["opendrive_sha256"] and comparison_id != "width":
        raise ValueError("OpenDRIVE source differs")
    if first["sample_count"] != second["sample_count"]:
        raise ValueError("observation window length differs")
    field = OBSERVED[comparison_id]
    measured_a = first["summary"][field]["mean"]
    measured_b = second["summary"][field]["mean"]
    if math.isclose(measured_a, measured_b, abs_tol=1e-9):
        raise ValueError("declared difference is absent from original measured conditions")
    if DIRECTION[comparison_id] * (measured_b - measured_a) <= 0:
        raise ValueError("measured comparison direction differs")
    return {
        "format": "c179789-comparison-audit-v1", "comparison_id": comparison_id,
        "case_ids": [first_id, second_id], "plan_sha256": hashlib.sha256(plan_bytes).hexdigest(),
        "authored_variable": variable, "observed_field": field,
        "setup_sha256": [first_hash, second_hash],
        "condition_sha256": [first["source"]["sha256"], second["source"]["sha256"]],
        "observed_means": [measured_a, measured_b],
        "fixed_setup_passed": True, "observed_difference_passed": True,
        "legal_judgment": "unresolved", "physical_acceptance_claimed": False,
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("plan", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("comparison_id")
    parser.add_argument("reference", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("alternative", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(audit(args.plan, args.comparison_id, args.reference, args.alternative), indent=2))

"""Independent saved-source and full-decode audit for one exact speed case.

Passing this CPU audit does not establish a reasonable/proper speed, visible
participants, or canonical physical acceptance. Original image review remains.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

from native_camera import VIEWS
from saved_conditions import FIELDS


SOURCES = ("authored-setup.json", "authored-setup-seal.json",
           "original-conditions.jsonl", "original-conditions-seal.json",
           "trace.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl", "media-receipt.json",
           "native-run-status.json")


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def document(path: Path) -> dict:
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("missing audit source: " + path.name)
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def rows(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("missing audit source: " + path.name)
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
            if line.strip()]


def _point(value, label: str) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
    if (not isinstance(value, list) or len(value) != 3 or
            any(type(x) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(x) for x in value)):
        raise ValueError("missing original participant position: " + label)
    return tuple(float(x) for x in value)


def _video(path: Path, width: int, height: int, trace: list[dict], name: str) -> dict:
    probe = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-count_frames",
                            "-select_streams", "v:0", "-show_entries",
                            "stream=codec_name,width,height,r_frame_rate,nb_read_frames",
                            "-of", "json", str(path)], capture_output=True, text=True,
                           check=True)
    streams = json.loads(probe.stdout).get("streams", [])
    if (len(streams) != 1 or streams[0].get("codec_name") != "ffv1" or
            streams[0].get("width") != width or streams[0].get("height") != height or
            streams[0].get("r_frame_rate") != "20/1" or
            streams[0].get("nb_read_frames") != "900"):
        raise ValueError("full video decode, dimensions or frame count differ: " + name)
    samples = (0, 450, 899)
    selector = "+".join(f"eq(n\\,{index})" for index in samples)
    decoded = subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-i", str(path),
                              "-vf", "select=" + selector, "-fps_mode", "passthrough",
                              "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "bgra", "pipe:1"],
                             capture_output=True, check=True).stdout
    stride = width * height * 4
    if len(decoded) != len(samples) * stride:
        raise ValueError("full video sample decode differs: " + name)
    sample_hashes = {}
    for offset, index in enumerate(samples):
        pixels = decoded[offset * stride:(offset + 1) * stride]
        expected = trace[index]["camera_sources"][name]
        digest = hashlib.sha256(pixels).hexdigest()
        if digest != expected.get("sha256"):
            raise ValueError("decoded original pixel hash differs: " + name)
        rgb = [pixels[i:i + 3] for i in range(0, len(pixels), 4)]
        if not any(any(pixel) for pixel in rgb) or len(set(rgb)) < 2:
            raise ValueError("decoded original pixels lack scene texture: " + name)
        sample_hashes[str(index)] = digest
    return {"sha256": sha(path), "frames_fully_decoded": 900, "fps": 20,
            "width": width, "height": height, "sample_sha256": sample_hashes,
            "actual_pixels_decoded": True,
            "participant_visibility_verified": False}


def audit(attempt: Path, *, diagnostic_test: bool = False,
          diagnostic_views=None) -> dict:
    """Independently rejoin retained sources and fully decode each view."""
    attempt = Path(attempt).resolve()
    if diagnostic_views is not None and not diagnostic_test:
        raise ValueError("diagnostic camera override requires diagnostic test mode")
    views = diagnostic_views if diagnostic_views is not None else VIEWS
    report_path = attempt / "analysis-report.json"
    result_path = attempt / "result.json"
    report, result = document(report_path), document(result_path)
    setup = document(attempt / "authored-setup.json")
    setup_seal = document(attempt / "authored-setup-seal.json")
    condition_seal = document(attempt / "original-conditions-seal.json")
    status = document(attempt / "native-run-status.json")
    media = document(attempt / "media-receipt.json")
    case = setup.get("case_id")
    plan = document(Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "case-plan.json")
    if (case not in {item["case_id"] for item in plan["cases"]} or
            report.get("case_id") != case or result.get("case_id") != case or
            setup_seal.get("case_id") != case or condition_seal.get("case_id") != case or
            status.get("case_id") != case):
        raise ValueError("audit exact case binding differs")
    if (setup_seal.get("sha256") != sha(attempt / "authored-setup.json") or
            condition_seal.get("sha256") != sha(attempt / "original-conditions.jsonl") or
            setup.get("source_packet_sha256") != media.get("source_packet_sha256") or
            status.get("errors") != [] or
            status.get("restoration", {}).get("restored") is not True or
            status.get("capture", {}).get("frames") != 900):
        raise ValueError("original capture seal, source or restoration differs")
    diagnostic = condition_seal.get("diagnostic_fixture")
    if diagnostic is not diagnostic_test or report.get("physical_acceptance_claimed") is not False or (
            result.get("physical_acceptance_claimed") is not False):
        raise ValueError("audit provenance or physical claim differs")
    expected_names = (*SOURCES, *(name + ".mkv" for name, _, _ in views))
    hashes = report.get("sources")
    if not isinstance(hashes, dict):
        raise ValueError("saved analysis source hashes missing")
    for name in expected_names:
        path = attempt / name
        if not path.is_file() or hashes.get(name) != sha(path):
            raise ValueError("missing or stale saved analysis source: " + name)
    if (media.get("trace_sha256") != hashes["trace.jsonl"] or
            media.get("frame_map_sha256") != hashes["video_frames.jsonl"] or
            media.get("frames") != 900 or
            media.get("video_sha256") !=
            {name: hashes[name + ".mkv"] for name, _, _ in views}):
        raise ValueError("original media receipt differs from saved analysis")
    trace = rows(attempt / "trace.jsonl")
    mapping = rows(attempt / "video_frames.jsonl")
    conditions = rows(attempt / "original-conditions.jsonl")
    if len(trace) != 900 or len(mapping) != 900 or len(conditions) != 900:
        raise ValueError("original 900-frame source set incomplete")
    actor_ids = conditions[0].get("source_ids", {})
    if not actor_ids.get("ego_actor_id") or not actor_ids.get("leader_actor_id"):
        raise ValueError("original participant actor identities missing")
    for index, (row, frame_map, condition) in enumerate(zip(trace, mapping, conditions)):
        frame, time_s = condition.get("frame"), condition.get("time_s")
        if (type(frame) is not int or type(time_s) not in (int, float) or
                row.get("frame") != frame or row.get("time_s") != time_s or
                frame_map.get("video_frame") != index or
                frame_map.get("native_frame") != frame or
                frame_map.get("carla_frame") != frame or
                frame_map.get("time_s") != time_s or
                condition.get("source_ids") != actor_ids or
                row.get("source_packet_sha256") != setup["source_packet_sha256"] or
                row.get("condition_sample_index") != index or
                (index and (frame != trace[index - 1]["frame"] + 1 or
                            not .049 <= time_s - trace[index - 1]["time_s"] <= .051))):
            raise ValueError("original participant/frame/time join differs")
        ego, leader = _point(row.get("position_m"), "ego"), _point(
            row.get("leader_position_m"), "leader")
        if math.dist(ego, leader) <= 0:
            raise ValueError("original participants overlap")
        cameras, camera_hashes = row.get("camera_sources"), frame_map.get("camera_source_sha256")
        if (not isinstance(cameras, dict) or not isinstance(camera_hashes, dict) or
                set(cameras) != {name for name, _, _ in views} or
                set(camera_hashes) != set(cameras)):
            raise ValueError("original four-camera join missing")
        for name, width, height in views:
            item = cameras[name]
            if (not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("frame") != frame or
                    item.get("width") != width or item.get("height") != height or
                    camera_hashes[name] != item.get("sha256") or
                    type(item.get("time_s")) not in (int, float) or
                    abs(item["time_s"] - time_s) > .05):
                raise ValueError("original camera identity differs")
    measured = result.get("measured_values", {})
    retained = measured.get("conditions", {})
    if (retained.get("sample_count") != 900 or
            retained.get("diagnostic_fixture") is not diagnostic_test or
            retained.get("full_history") != conditions or
            retained.get("source", {}).get("sha256") != hashes["original-conditions.jsonl"] or
            result.get("measured_values", {}).get("legal_judgment") != "unresolved" or
            result.get("trace_reference") != "trace.jsonl" or
            result.get("video_frame_map_reference") != "video_frames.jsonl" or
            result.get("video_references") != [name + ".mkv" for name, _, _ in views]):
        raise ValueError("saved Native result differs from original sources")
    steady = {name: sum(row[name] for row in conditions[180:]) / 720 for name in FIELDS}
    travel = math.dist(_point(trace[0]["position_m"], "first ego"),
                       _point(trace[-1]["position_m"], "last ego"))
    observation = report.get("measurements", {}).get("basic_speed_observation", {})
    value = observation.get("value", {})
    if (measured.get("steady_means") != steady or
            measured.get("travel_progress_m") != travel or
            value.get("steady_means") != steady or
            value.get("travel_progress_m") != travel or
            value.get("source_ids") != actor_ids or
            value.get("legal_judgment") != "unresolved" or
            observation.get("sources") != {name: hashes[name] for name in
                                           ("authored-setup.json", "original-conditions.jsonl",
                                            "trace.jsonl")} or
            result.get("maneuver_completed") is not (travel >= .25)):
        raise ValueError("saved measurement differs from original values")
    requests = setup.get("variables", {})
